subject.title: Feature: Private Mode for demos and content creation

question: What exact guarantee and activation authority should private sessions have across workspace access, transcripts, memory, plugins, tools, logs, media, channels, and operator metadata?
rationale: Implementation cannot be safely scoped until maintainers decide whether this means demo context isolation, ephemeral conversation history, or a comprehensive no-read/no-write privacy boundary and identify any retained operational metadata.

options.title: Full Private Session
options.body: Guarantee no personal workspace reads and no durable conversation, memory, plugin-index, tool-artifact, or media writes except narrowly documented operational metadata.

options.title: Ephemeral History Only
options.body: Prevent transcript and memory persistence while retaining ordinary workspace and tool access under a narrower user-facing name.

options.title: Demo Context Mode
options.body: Suppress bootstrap context and workspace tools for presentations without promising that session data is never persisted.

recommendation.title: Full Private Session
recommendation.body: Guarantee no personal workspace reads and no durable conversation, memory, plugin-index, tool-artifact, or media writes except narrowly documented operational metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: This person supplied the prior canonical review and is connected to recent work on the core session contract and persistence surfaces.
